title: Bank of America puts 4,000 people on fixing vulnerabilities uncovered by Anthropic's Mythos and other AI models
key_facts: Bank of America hired 1,000 outside contractors to fix software vulnerabilities uncovered by AI models such as Anthropic's Mythos, CNBC reports
They work alongside 3,000 internal employees, a total of 4,000 people, since the second quarter, according to CEO Brian Moynihan
Moynihan said the bank spent a few hundred million dollars in the third quarter on the software work and anti-money-laundering requirements combined, with no separate figure for patching

Anthropic released Mythos in April only to select partners through Project Glasswing, saying it found thousands of serious vulnerabilities; OpenAI followed in May with its Daybreak cybersecurity programme
Bank of America is one of the first major US companies to disclose how many people it has put on AI-found vulnerabilities; Moynihan expects patching costs to fall over time
